message: I always keep a flashlight handy on the kitchen counter, just in case the power decides to play hide and seek. It’s funny how the kids think they can outsmart a blackout by making a fort in the living room! But really, it’s all about staying cozy and having a little fun in the dark. Do your kids have any funny blackout stories?
scene: a kitchen counter with a flashlight, matches in a jar, and a notepad (slightly cluttered, lived-in room)
